summary: The dark theme layout is mostly coherent, but a code hover popover obscures code lines, and bottom alignment between main columns is uneven.

issues.title: Code popover obscures active source lines
issues.description: Hover popover renders directly over the inspected code tokens, obstructing lines 1 through 6.
issues.evidence: Popover container overlaps and hides code text in lines 1–6 of the pane.
issues.suggestion: Offset the popover above the token or adjust placement to prevent covering code.

issues.title: Mismatched column container heights
issues.description: Bottom edges of the source code pane and the test event panel do not align.
issues.evidence: The right test event card extends further down than the CodePane card.
issues.suggestion: Set consistent card heights across the two-column grid.
